night_start.tl: Lumulubog na ang araw. Hanggang umaga, kapit lang!
night_start.en: The sun is setting. Hold on until morning!

tabi_tabi.tl: Tabi-tabi po! Narinig tayo ng mga duwende, mukhang mabait sila ngayong gabi.
tabi_tabi.en: Excuse us, spirits! The duwende heard us, and they seem kind tonight.

spawn_aswang.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa hilaga. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang.en: An aswang is coming from the north. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_north.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa hilaga. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_north.en: An aswang is coming from the north. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_east.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa silangan. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_east.en: An aswang is coming from the east. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_south.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa timog. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_south.en: An aswang is coming from the south. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_aswang_west.tl: May aswang na paparating mula sa kanluran. Bantayan ang nag-iisa!
spawn_aswang_west.en: An aswang is coming from the west. Watch whoever is alone!

spawn_tikbalang.en: Feel those footsteps? That's a tikbalang.

spawn_kapre.tl: Amoy tabako... may kapre sa puno.
spawn_kapre.en: Smells like tobacco... there's a kapre in the tree.

spawn_duwende.tl: Ingat sa anting-anting, may maliit na kamay na gustong humawak.
spawn_duwende.en: Guard the charm, a little hand wants it.

last_turn.tl: Huling dilim na. Konting tiis na lang!
last_turn.en: Last stretch of dark. Just a little longer!

win.tl: Sumikat na ang araw! Ligtas ang baryo.
win.en: The sun is up. The barrio is safe.

lose.tl: Nasira ang kubo... Subukan ulit bukas ng gabi.
lose.en: The kubo fell... Try again tomorrow night.

quiet.tl: Tahimik ang gabi. Hinga muna, tapos handa ulit.
quiet.en: The night is quiet. Breathe, then get ready again.

quiet.tl: Umiihip ang hangin sa bukid. Abangan ang susunod.
quiet.en: The wind stirs over the fields. Watch for what comes next.

quiet.tl: Walang gumagalaw sa dilim. Sa ngayon.
quiet.en: Nothing moves in the dark. For now.

kapre_smoke_telegraph.tl: Amoy tabako... may usok na lalabas sa kapre. Tabi-tabi po, lumayo kung kaya!
kapre_smoke_telegraph.en: Smells like tobacco... smoke is about to roll out of the kapre. Excuse us, spirits! Step away if you can!

kapre_smoke_telegraph.tl: Humihithit ang kapre sa puno. Paparating ang makapal na usok.
kapre_smoke_telegraph.en: The kapre is puffing in the tree. Thick smoke is coming.

kapre_smoke_hit.tl: Nabalot ng usok ng kapre si [unit]. Hindi muna ito makakatira palabas.
kapre_smoke_hit.en: The kapre's smoke swallowed [unit]. It cannot attack out for now.

kapre_smoke_hit.tl: Ubo-ubo! Nasa loob ng usok si [unit].
kapre_smoke_hit.en: Cough, cough! [unit] is inside the smoke.

unit_returned.tl: Nakabalik na si [unit] mula sa gubat. Salamat sa mga nagbantay!
unit_returned.en: [unit] is back from the woods. Thanks to those who kept watch!

badge_earned.tl: Panalo! May bagong badge na si [unit]: [badge].
badge_earned.en: Well done! [unit] earned a new badge: [badge].

scar_gained.tl: May bakas ng laban si [unit]. Pero lalaban pa rin!
scar_gained.en: [unit] carries a mark of the fight. Still fighting!

object_recognized.tl: Kilala ka na namin, [unit]! Welcome back sa baryo.
object_recognized.en: We know you, [unit]! Welcome back to the barrio.

recap_win.tl: Kagabi, nakaligtas kayo hanggang umaga. [beaten] nilalang ang napaalis ninyo sa loob ng [turns] turn.
recap_win.en: Last night you made it to sunrise. You drove off [beaten] creatures in [turns] turns.

recap_win.tl: Kagabi, ligtas ang baryo dahil sa inyo. [beaten] ang natalo, [downed] ang bumagsak.
recap_win.en: Last night the barrio was safe because of you. [beaten] beaten, [downed] went down.

recap_lose.tl: Kagabi, bumagsak ang kubo pagkatapos ng [turns] turn. Bawi tayo ngayong gabi.
recap_lose.en: Last night the kubo fell after [turns] turns. Let's win it back tonight.

recap_lose.tl: Kagabi, nahirapan ang baryo. [beaten] ang natalo ninyo bago mag-umaga, pero hindi pa tapos ang laban.
recap_lose.en: Last night the barrio struggled. You beat [beaten] before dawn, but the fight is not over.

recap_scar.tl: May bakas ng laban si [unit], pero handa pa rin.
recap_scar.en: [unit] carries a mark of the fight but is still ready.
